name: Jan Vermeer
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his mechanical engineering studies at Delft University, when a Formula Student project sparked an enduring passion. He initially focused on vehicle dynamics and simulation, quickly developing an aptitude for data analysis and problem-solving. After graduating, Jan spent several years in European touring car racing, honing his skills in real-world track environments. He moved to Australia and joined Brad Jones Racing, drawn to the team's commitment to innovation and competitive spirit. 

As a performance engineer, Jan is known for his meticulous approach and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and crew. He emphasizes continuous improvement and collaboration, fostering a positive and productive environment within the team. What sets Jan apart is his dedication to mentoring junior engineers, ensuring the next generation is well-equipped to tackle the challenges of modern motorsport. He aims to see Brad Jones Racing at the top of the podium.

physical.description: A sturdy man of medium height, Jan has the focused look of someone perpetually analyzing data.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical observations.
Insists on having a specific type of Dutch licorice in his desk drawer.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
